paper_metadata.title: Strengthening and high-temperature softening resistance of low Si-added Cu–Cr–Zr alloy for fusion reactor application

evidence.quote: Cu – Cr – Zr alloy, as a kind of precipitation-hardening alloy, is being widely favored by more researchers in recent years

The peak-aged Cu – Cr – Zr alloy containing Si exhibits higher ultimate tensile strength of 622 MPa, yield strength of 588 MPa with a considerable elongation of 17% and electrical conductivity of 76% IACS.

After annealing, the size of Cr precipitates in the alloy with Si addition is significantly lower than that of alloy without Si, whereas the volume fraction of Cr precipitates in alloy with Si addition is almost identical to that in Si-free alloy.
